work.title: Canonical run-backed Sites Engagement preview
authority: Direct request to create /sites-preview from recovered Sites composition, limited to the Engagement page and existing canonical run API.

intent.productGoal: Provide a Sites-composition Engagement preview that orients healthcare QoR reviewers on actual persisted-run conditions without substituting invented figures or authority.
intent.capability: A static /sites-preview page accepts ?run=..., reads the existing canonical run API, and renders its gates, reconciliations, findings, source inventory, contextual drawer, and workflow/lens navigation.
architecturalIntent: The isolated preview is a read-only static asset served by the existing Workbench and calls only GET /api/runs/:id.
The recovered Sites implementation is a composition reference; its illustrative data, local calculation, simulated review, and simulated release state are excluded.
Engagement remains an overview lens adjacent to, not a replacement for, the seven existing canonical workflow capabilities.
invariants: Root, /next, backend/API, canonical calculations, source evidence, review authority, and workbook remain unchanged.
Unreconciled differences, findings, and non-passed gates remain visible and are never locally reconciled or approved.
The preview makes no mutations, financial calculation, professional decision, approval, or release inference.
A missing reconciliation-to-document thread is disclosed instead of fabricated.
acceptanceEvidence: node --check validates the preview script and existing parallel Workbench script.
pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run build validate the Workbench after the port.
Existing http://127.0.0.1:4173 returns the preview assets and persisted-run API response with HTTP 200.
Diff review confirms protected root, /next, backend, and build surfaces are unchanged.

decisions.decision: Require a run query parameter rather than selecting or inventing a default run.
decisions.rationale: The selected persisted run remains the sole authority for displayed healthcare QoR values and state.

decisions.decision: Keep the Sites drawer but provide run-level inventory with an explicit source-thread limitation.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the contextual-drawer interaction without claiming evidence relationships the canonical API does not expose.

decisions.decision: Retain lens and navigation interactions as client-side presentation only.
decisions.rationale: They preserve visual composition without creating calculations, decisions, approvals, or release authority.

observedBehaviour: GET /api/runs/c8f21c7f-82a5-47a1-9d21-ab78af14660a returned HTTP 200 with 8 gates, 4 reconciliations, 1 finding, and 7 source inventory records.
GET /sites-preview/index.html?run=c8f21c7f-82a5-47a1-9d21-ab78af14660a, its stylesheet, and its JavaScript each returned HTTP 200 from the existing port 4173.
The observed canonical state includes a 453,931-cent ar-to-gl difference, open/blocked gates, and unset materiality; the port presents it rather than changing it.

evidence.reference: apps/workbench: node --check public/sites-preview/app.js; node --check public/next/workbench-next.js; pnpm run typecheck; pnpm run build; git diff --check
evidence.result: Passed. Build copied the preview into the ignored static dist output.
All requested preview assets and canonical API response returned HTTP 200.

evidence.reference: git diff -- apps/workbench/public/index.html apps/workbench/public/app.js apps/workbench/server.mjs apps/workbench/build.mjs apps/workbench/public/next/index.html apps/workbench/public/next/workbench-next.js
evidence.result: No diff in protected root, backend/build, or /next surfaces.
Records the source-port mapping, actual run evidence, preserved authority boundaries, and known API-thread limitation.

divergences.expected: A Sites-style selected reconciliation can open a source-document-specific evidence trail.
divergences.observed: The existing canonical API provides run-level source inventory and finding references but no reconciliation-specific document/calculation/review thread identity.

divergences.expected: A browser-rendered screenshot would provide visual runtime evidence.
divergences.observed: No installed browser automation or browser executable was available in this session; HTTP asset/API traces and syntax/build validation were captured instead.

learning.recurringPattern: Illustrative composition ports need a strict separation between reusable layout/interaction patterns and non-reusable business facts or simulated authority.
durableKnowledge: The static Workbench server serves new files under public immediately at port 4173; build copies them to ignored dist assets without starting a second server.
The canonical run API can support condition-first engagement orientation but cannot attribute a reconciliation to a specific source-document/calculation/review thread.
